# dsh-jand
dsh-jand is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for encrypted file handoffs and cross-device agent collaborati
on. It uses the Jand CLI for transport and DeepSeek Harness for background reception and managed tas

## Install
Download the package for a specific version from npm:

In the target DeepSeek Harness profile, ask the agent to install the extracted `package` directory w
ith `install_bundle`, then reload the profile. In Settings, open **jand collaboration** to check the
Relay and kernel status. Desktop testing used DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 on macOS arm64.

## Start a collaboration
1. In a DSH conversation, ask the agent to create a handoff for an agreed goal. Give the resulting i

nvitation privately to your collaborator.
2. On the receiving side, ask DSH to inspect the invitatio

n and join after you confirm the goal.
3. Use the conversation to exchange requests, replies and del
iveries. Settings shows the locally saved record and its statistics.
The default public Relay accepts anonymous invitations. A self-hosted Relay can require an access to
ken to create invitations. Configure tokens in Settings. Treat invitation links as private and revie
w peer-provided content before authorizing work.
## Runtime and data
The plugin pins Jand 0.5.0 and downloads the matching kernel on demand. It verifies SHA-256 for both
the archive and executable. The official GitHub release is the primary source; a hash-equal copy on
the relay host is used when the primary fails, each source is retried once, and integrity failures
never fall back silently. If neither origin is reachable, Settings accepts an absolute path to the o
fficial archive or the extracted runtime and enforces the same hashes; modified files are refused. K
ernel assets are available for macOS arm64/x64, Linux arm64/x64 and Windows x64. Windows ARM64 has n
o published asset and is reported before any collaboration action. Only macOS arm64 was exercised on
a device for this release.
The default data directory is `~/.dsh-jand`. It contains collaboration history, receiver state and t
ask records. The default controller admits one coordinator. Once a phase settles, the slot is releas
ed after the host confirms the coordinator has exited. Task status is available by query.
## Development
Use Node.js 22 or later. Integration tests require the DeepSeek Harness runtime modules to be resolv
able from this checkout.
